Team — forwarding Jamie's questions (below). Draft answers I propose we send back to unblock SecOps/Legal. Please flag corrections or additions; aim to send by 08:30 PT.

Draft answers (concise, non-legal):
1) Prompts: By default, Redwood Hosted processes prompts in-memory and persists short-lived request logs for debugging. Default retention for raw prompt payloads in hosted is 7 days for telemetry only; prompts are not used for model training. For stricter controls we offer an ephemeral-only option (no persistent storage of prompts) that keeps request data in RAM and KV caches with TTL=120s and does not write to disk.

2) Generated outputs: Default hosted behavior is to stream outputs and retain generation transcripts in logs for 30 days for troubleshooting (redacted on request). Customers can opt into 0-day retention (ephemeral-only) or move to Dedicated/Private for configured retention policies.

3) Telemetry & logs: We capture request metadata (timestamps, model id, route, size) for 30 days by default. Per-token-level debug traces are retained only when debug mode is enabled and have a default TTL of 7 days; these traces are disabled by default for production routes. IP addresses and access logs are retained 90 days for security monitoring; we can reduce to 30 days for pilot with contractual commitment.

4) Embeddings/Indexing: Embeddings are not stored by Redwood unless the customer opts in. For retrieval workflows we recommend storing vectors in your VPC or using Redwood's Dedicated vector store pinned to a region. Private deployments support full customer-controlled vector persistence.

5) Encryption/KMS: Hosted uses envelope encryption; keys are service-managed by default. Dedicated and Private support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-KMS/HSM) so keys and root-of-trust remain in your control. We can provide KMS integration docs for AWS/GCP/Azure.

6) Evidence: We can share our SOC 2 Type II report under NDA and provide sample audit logs that show role-based access events and key rotation timestamps. For contractual audits we support time-windowed log exports.

Notes: 
- Residency: Hosted (US) runs in US-East by default. For strict US-only residency we recommend Dedicated reserved capacity or Private deployment.
- Redaction: We offer pre-ingest redaction hooks and field-level filters to remove PHI before it reaches logging.

Next step I suggest: send the above to Jamie, offer the 20-minute SecOps readout with Marissa and Ben; include attachments.

Thanks,
Priyom

Jamie — thanks again for the call and for laying out the concerns clearly. Below are concise answers your SecOps/Legal team asked for. Happy to expand any bullet.

1) Prompts
- Default (Hosted): Prompts are processed in-memory and request payloads are persisted in telemetry logs for 7 days (default) and are not used for model training.
- Options: Ephemeral-only mode (no disk persistence, KV cache TTL 120s) available on Hosted if required for pilot. Dedicated/Private can be configured to never persist prompts to shared storage.

2) Generated outputs
- Default: Generation transcripts retained in logs for 30 days for troubleshooting.
- Options: 0-day retention (ephemeral) available; Dedicated/Private allow custom retention or no retention with contractual controls.

3) Telemetry & logs
- Default: request metadata retained 30 days; per-token debug traces only when explicitly enabled (7 days). Access logs/IPs retained 90 days by default; can be reduced to 30 days for pilot under agreement.

4) Embeddings/Indexing
- By default we do NOT store embeddings unless explicitly requested. For retrieval use-cases we recommend storing vectors in your environment (VPC) or using Dedicated vector storage pinned to a region.

5) Encryption/KMS & residency
- Envelope encryption service-managed by default (hosted). Dedicated and Private support customer-managed keys (BYOK).
- Hosted US regions (US-East) available for the pilot; Dedicated/Private required for strict contractual US-only residency with audited controls.

6) Evidence and auditability
- SOC 2 Type II report available under NDA. We can provide sample audit logs (RBAC events, key rotation) and a bridge letter for your procurement team.
